title: Service-Currency Credit for Household Plans — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
A service-currency credit is taken off the price of an Alignment Services & Plans household plan, by the date of the latest alignment booked as included in the plan on the household plan the customer already holds, counted in whole calendar months before the new purchase:

| Latest included alignment on the household plan | Credit |
|---|---|
| no more than 6 whole calendar months before the purchase | 10.00 |
| more than 6 but no more than 12 whole calendar months before | 5.00 |
| older, or no included alignment on the household plan | 0.00 |

The credit is worked out on its own and taken off the household price, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical):** 6 whole months before → 10.00, 7 → 5.00; 12 whole months before → 5.00, 13 → 0.00.
